findings.finding: The adjudicated route, all six checked active decision/review artifacts, sidecar replacement payload, complete shared sidecars, their current Daniel partitions, and the three local textual source files are bound to the SHA-256 values in this report.

Expanding the 42 route spans, decision spans, chunk spans, and packet spans independently against the canonical eng-web Daniel inventory yields all 357 verses exactly once, in canonical order, from Dan.1.1 through Dan.12.13, with zero gap, overlap, or ordering error.

All 84 structured decision-level WEB observations match the canonical translation witness strings exactly, including punctuation and Unicode. Every decision has one complete-verse opening witness and one complete-verse closing witness, and every chunk preserves the identical observation pair.

All 328 recursively observed packet source sets contain the exact direct_read eng-web active span plus an exactly paired OSHB and UXLC locator. No structured source identifier other than oshb or uxlc occurs, and all 656 WLC-family locator objects are syntactically equal to the packet's active WEB span.

Syntactic span equality is insufficient in Daniel 4-6. The local WEB witness has chapter counts 3:30, 4:37, 5:31, and 6:28, whereas both correlated WLC-family XML views have 3:33, 4:34, 5:30, and 6:29. Consequently, 160 OSHB/UXLC locator objects attached to ten decisions cite existing coordinates but not the corresponding source passage content.

Every decision and chunk explicitly says that OSHB and UXLC are correlated WLC-family evidence rather than independent witnesses, uses translation_textual_order_and_form_evidence_only authority, and preserves the roots-are-not-meaning guard. All 126 primary reviews are marked evidence_only, and all 42 packets count the shared-model mesh as one correlated voice.

No structured Old Greek, Theodotion, Qumran, rabbinic, or Second-Temple primary locator, quotation, reading, or ruling appears in the checked artifacts. Mentions of those sources are unavailability disclosures, canon guards, textual-pressure warnings, or requests for later specialist review; none simulates evidence or selects a canon, witness, reading, chronology, identity, fulfillment, or theology.

Hebrew-to-Aramaic and Aramaic-to-Hebrew transitions, roots, morphology, qere-ketiv, section markers, and versification are consistently framed as evidence only. The mid-verse language transition at 2:4 is not turned into an unsupported half-verse chunk, and the WEB-to-MT numbering difference is not treated as literary or canon authority.

The three held decisions have decision-local active appeals and specific external-model-plus-human questions. Two held decisions are also affected by the blocking locator defect, so their honest hold status does not make the current source packet complete.

All 22 relation rows are candidate-only, non-authorizing, and boundary_authority=false. Every referenced decision identifier resolves to one of the 42 active Daniel decisions, and no relation establishes canon, witness priority, harmonized chronology, ruler identity, fulfillment, theology, or boundary authority.

Each installed shared sidecar contains exactly three Daniel rows and its current Daniel partition exactly matches reviews/Dan/sidecar_rows_v2.json. The rows are only the three held medium-low decisions M7_sol-Dan-016, M7_sol-Dan-021, and M7_sol-Dan-040; no accepted or medium/high decision leaked into a Daniel sidecar partition.
